references.text: Moses gave land to the tribe of Gad as part of the distribution of the land east of the Jordan, which was promised to Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
The tribes of Gad and Reuben asked Moses for land east of the Jordan because the area was well suited for their livestock.
Moses describes how he gave the land east of the Jordan to the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
A reminder that God gave the land to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh as an inheritance.
Earlier in the same chapter it is mentioned that Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh had already received their inheritance from Moses east of the Jordan.
Joshua sends the tribe of Gad back to their inherited land east of the Jordan, which Moses had given them.
